lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Fe2N4O6 (reduced formula FeNO3) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Fe centers in octahedral environments with three N and three O neighbors, while N centers have two Fe neighbors and O centers have four neighbors (one Fe, two N, one O). Polyhedral sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between Fe octahedra and edge-sharing between N-centered four-vertex polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites.
